note: The round runner's reading of why each of the 10 texts the layer released and the labelers labeled misstates_order passed version 2.2. These are not blind labels. In every case the printed drug name, dose, route, and frequency match the order's structured fields; the misstatement is a condition or schedule that the record carries in a field the reader admits by grammar and never reads as text (an order id, a Medication id, a Bundle id, a meta versionId), in a resource of a type the reader skips (a Flag, a Communication), or a Medication resource that a labeler resolved differently from the reader. None comes from the model's text; the model's words produced unsupported claims only. The source field says whether the record (record) or the model's words (model_text) carry what the text leaves out or contradicts.

misstatements.detail: the order id is warfarin-hold-if-inr-above-3; the id grammar admits 1 to 64 letters, digits, hyphens, and periods, and the reader never reads an id as text
misstatements.text: Take Warfarin 5 mg by mouth once a day.
